
DELETE-STEP
Delete a step from a scenario

USAGE
  fspec delete-step <file> <scenario> <step>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name
  <step> (required)
    Step text, with or without its keyword (e.g. "Given I am logged in" or "I am logged in"); text matching several steps is refused, so add the keyword to pick one

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Delete step (its data table or doc string goes with it)
  $ fspec delete-step spec/features/login.feature "Login with valid credentials" "And I see the dashboard"
  ✓ Deleted step from scenario

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-step
  fspec update-step
